claims: An annual flu shot is recommended for everyone 6 months and older.
An annual flu shot is ideally recommended by the end of October.
The 2025-26 flu season features trivalent vaccines.
Trivalent vaccines guard against three main virus strains.
It takes about two weeks for antibodies to develop after flu vaccination.
Flu shots are available at pharmacies.
Flu shots are available at doctor's offices.
Flu shots are available at health departments.
Most insurance plans cover the flu vaccine.
Medicare Part B covers the flu vaccine.
Flu vaccine options include standard inactivated shots administered by needle.
Nasal spray flu vaccines are available rarely for specific age groups.
The flu vaccine cannot cause the flu.
Flu vaccine side effects are usually mild and short-lived.
A COVID-19 vaccine and a flu shot can be received at the same time.
